environment: Node, python3 3.x, scratch git repo from cli-runner; no network

cases.title: scenario-runner holds the exact worktree command and no literal
cases.given: slice commit 28d6cce, prompt files read from disk
cases.when: the test reads the prompt text and applies the guard regex
cases.then: Exact command appears once; swapped, literal and respelled variants are absent; guard matches a literal variant
cases.expected: Exact command appears once; swapped, literal and respelled variants are absent; guard matches a literal variant
cases.actual: Exact command appears once; swapped, literal and respelled variants are absent; guard matches a literal variant

cases.title: env-detector holds three run branch placeholders, the parsed kind phrase and the sdlc/{name} default
cases.given: slice commit 28d6cce, prompt files read from disk
cases.when: the test reads the prompt text and applies the guard regex
cases.then: count(<run branch>) >= 3, phrase present, no sdlc/run- or glob, sdlc/{name} still present
cases.expected: count(<run branch>) >= 3, phrase present, no sdlc/run- or glob, sdlc/{name} still present
cases.actual: count(<run branch>) >= 3, phrase present, no sdlc/run- or glob, sdlc/{name} still present

cases.title: branches.py parse returns kind run for sdlc/run-2 under the default format
cases.given: slice commit 28d6cce, prompt files read from disk
cases.when: the test reads the prompt text and applies the guard regex
cases.then: sdlc/run-2 gives kind run, sdlc/S-003 slice, sdlc/M-1 milestone, sdlc/run-2-x kind null; tree unchanged
cases.expected: sdlc/run-2 gives kind run, sdlc/S-003 slice, sdlc/M-1 milestone, sdlc/run-2-x kind null; tree unchanged
cases.actual: sdlc/run-2 gives kind run, sdlc/S-003 slice, sdlc/M-1 milestone, sdlc/run-2-x kind null; tree unchanged

evidence.title: parse outputs
evidence.inline:
sdlc/run-2 -> exit 0 kind=run n=2
sdlc/S-003 -> kind=slice
sdlc/M-1 -> kind=milestone
sdlc/run-2-x -> kind=null

cases.title: milestone-writer holds all three placeholders and no literal, including in code spans
cases.given: slice commit 28d6cce, prompt files read from disk
cases.when: the test reads the prompt text and applies the guard regex
cases.then: Three placeholders present; no sdlc/M-, sdlc/<id>-e2e or loop literal in any code span
cases.expected: Three placeholders present; no sdlc/M-, sdlc/<id>-e2e or loop literal in any code span
cases.actual: Three placeholders present; no sdlc/M-, sdlc/<id>-e2e or loop literal in any code span

cases.title: e2e-harness holds both placeholders and no literal
cases.given: slice commit 28d6cce, prompt files read from disk
cases.when: the test reads the prompt text and applies the guard regex
cases.then: Both placeholders present; no sdlc/<milestoneId>-e2e or sdlc/M-
cases.expected: Both placeholders present; no sdlc/<milestoneId>-e2e or sdlc/M-
cases.actual: Both placeholders present; no sdlc/<milestoneId>-e2e or sdlc/M-

cases.title: guard property: 1200 seeded mutations of the four prompts
cases.given: slice commit 28d6cce, prompt files read from disk
cases.when: the test reads the prompt text and applies the guard regex
cases.then: Every injected literal, in 5 wrappers and 10 forms, matches; sdlc/{name} injected never matches; allowed text never matches
cases.expected: Every injected literal, in 5 wrappers and 10 forms, matches; sdlc/{name} injected never matches; allowed text never matches
cases.actual: Every injected literal, in 5 wrappers and 10 forms, matches; sdlc/{name} injected never matches; allowed text never matches
cases.specSource: R-132 acceptance R-133 acceptance R-144 acceptance R-148 acceptance

cases.title: Injecting a literal into a scratch copy of each prompt fails its pinned test
cases.when: one line per prompt is changed to a literal and the matching T-R test runs
cases.then: T-R-132, T-R-133, T-R-144 and T-R-148 each fail

evidence.title: mutation probes
evidence.inline:
scenario-runner -b sdlc/M-1-e2e-x -> T-R-132 fail
env-detector git checkout -b sdlc/run-2 -> T-R-133 fail
milestone-writer <milestone branch> -> sdlc/M-1 -> T-R-144 fail
e2e-harness <e2e branch> -> sdlc/M-1-e2e -> T-R-148 fail

cases.title: prompts.test.mjs and the full npm test pass on the slice commit
